subject: Coverage declaration, portal access & endorsement request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@cirrusworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2023 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage declaration, portal access & endorsement request

Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for moving quickly on this. We're getting CirrusWorks queued for PO setup in our procurement system. To complete vendor activation we need:

- Certificate of Insurance showing general liability and cyber liability limits (current policy period).
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (we'll need this for vendor record).
- Portal credentials or a direct upload link so our vendor operations team can pull the docs.

Please attach the files to this thread or upload them to the link below and reply with the access token so we can auto-ingest: https://vendor-uploads.redwood.com (if you already have an account, please share the org email).

Two quick policy notes from our risk team (cc'd):
- We typically ask for an Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." and a Waiver of Subrogation where available. If CirrusWorks cannot provide those, flag it here and we can discuss conditional PO terms.
- If you use subcontractors, please list their names and whether they perform any work that handles customer data.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (filled by CirrusWorks procurement intake — stub).

Can you confirm ETA for the COI? We're aiming to issue a conditional PO by end of this week.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf]

From: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@cirrusworks.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: CirrusWorks Legal <legal@cirrusworks.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2023 14:38:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage declaration, portal access & endorsement request

Hi Diego —

Appreciate the clear list. I've attached our current COI and W-9 to this reply.

Attachments:
- CirrusWorks_CoI_20230725.pdf (general liability, cyber)
- CirrusWorks_W9.pdf

We don't currently have an Additional Insured endorsement on file for general customers by default; we can request one from our broker. Our broker typically charges a processing fee for endorsements and the turnaround is 7-10 business days. I can open the request immediately if you confirm the exact endorsement language ("Redwood Inference, Inc." as additional insured and Waiver of Subrogation).

Portal access: we have a vendor portal — I created a one-time upload link for Redwood operations: https://vendor-portal.cirrusworks.io/upload?token=eyJ0eXAi. Use the link to download or confirm files. If you prefer SFTP, we can set that up (requires an account).

Let me know if you want me to request the endorsement now.

Best,
Lisa Cho
Head of Ops, CirrusWorks
[lisa.cho@cirrusworks.io | +1 415-555-0183]

[attachments: CirrusWorks_CoI_20230725.pdf, CirrusWorks_W9.pdf]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@cirrusworks.io>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2023 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage declaration, portal access & endorsement request

Hi Lisa —

Thanks for the fast follow-up and for sharing the COI and W-9. A few clarifying asks from Redwood Risk:

1) Please request an Additional Insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" on your General Liability policy.
2) Please request a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, where permitted by law.
3) Confirm whether CirrusWorks uses subcontractors for provisioning or onboarding work. If yes, provide the subcontractor names and whether they process or view customer data.
4) Can you also confirm there are no pending claims on the GL or cyber policies in the last 24 months? If there are claims, provide a brief summary (date, type, reserve/settlement if any).

Portal token worked for download. If you can open the endorsement request now, please attach the broker ticket reference and ETA so procurement can move the PO to issuance (we're targeting a conditional PO). If endorsement will be delayed beyond 10 business days, share any expedited fee amounts up-front so we can evaluate.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Risk Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Neha —

I've opened the broker request for an Additional Insured endorsement and Waiver of Subrogation. Broker ticket ID: 4572. Estimated processing time is 8 business days and there is a $75 administrative fee to issue the endorsement. I've attached the broker reply (ticket stub) and uploaded the COI/W-9 to our portal in the vendor docs folder.

Attachments: endorsement_request_ticket-4572.txt (contains broker reference and ETA).

We do use one subcontractor (BrightPath IT) for onboarding scripting; they do not have access to customer PII and access is restricted. I attached the subcontractor declaration in the portal folder.

I will update this thread when the endorsement is issued and attach the formal endorsement PDF.

Regards,
Lisa
